messages:
ishu: Quick heads-up — ran the quick-eval pack for customer 'Stargazer' after the LoRA merge on astro-7b-int4. Found a few behavioral regressions on numeric extraction and a tokenizer mismatch for some emoji sequences.
kevin: link to results -> https://redwood.internal/evals/4342 (summary: 12/22 prompts regressed small->medium)
maria: I re-ran locally with q2-kv quant preset. Throughput + cost look good, but for the invoice prompt we see amount hallucinations (missing currency symbol, wrong magnitude).
maria: failing example:
```
prompt: "Total due: ?
Invoice items: 3 x $19.99"
baseline (float16): "Total due: $59.97"
stargazer-lora-int4: "Total due: 5997"
```
sam: saw a perf dip when continuous-batching kicked in at seq_len 1024 — p50 latency jumped ~25ms. Trace shows KV cache misses: `cache_lookup: miss_count=42` during the merged weights warmstart.
deploy-bot: smoke job #432 completed — results: unit-tests 5/5, smoke-suite 3/5, quant-sanity 1/2. Logs: https://redwood.internal/jobs/432/logs
eva: Proposed action: 1) hold rollout, 2) add targeted prompts for numeric+emoji cases to quickpack, 3) run warmstart with cold-KV replay, 4) try int4 variant with FP fallback on numeric decoding. Assignments? @maria to expand quickpack, @kevin to run warmstart experiments, @sam to investigate batching policy thresholds.
kevin: will do warmstart experiments and push trace logs here. Also will test fallback config `fallback.decode_numeric_as_fp=true` in canary.
maria: I'll add ~15 edge cases including localized currencies and emoji sequences. Sharing CSV in a bit.
sam: For batching threshold — we should try lowering continuous batching window from 20ms -> 10ms for this config and re-run smoke. I can schedule a run tomorrow morning.
eva: Thanks. If warmstart + fallback fixes numeric drift, we can do a limited canary on Dedicated pool and watch cost/latency for 24h. Otherwise plan is to revert merge and open a triage with the customer. :eyes:
ishu: noted. tagging customer success to flag Stargazer. cc @kevin @maria
kevin: quick note — tokenizer mismatch seems to be because their dataset used U+FE0F emoji variants. I'll add a normalization pre-step in the eval harness to test.
maria: uploaded quickpack CSV: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/quickpacks/stargazer-v1.csv
eva: ok let's reconvene after the warmstart run. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
